name: draft-then-review
description: Composition (kind: 'flow'): two saved flows as two nodes, one wallet, one tree. refine-loop drafts and iterates the artifact at --arg file= against --arg task=; proposal-gate then reviews the same file as a human-owned document. Both children compose LEGALLY: refine-loop heals with rollback: false (the loop pattern) and proposal-gate does not heal at all - a rollback-healing gate inside a composed child is the verify error rollback-heal-in-child until scope-narrowing exists, which is why sdlc-e2e's phases (rollback heals) cannot be composed yet. Each child runs in a real run dir under <run>/children/ that status, explain and steer take directly; a resume after a child block re-enters the child and re-runs only what blocked.
